name: Karen M. Williams
service_line_reviewed: Article III service reviewed: 2022–13 September 2026. Selected decisions: 1.

biography.text: Born in 1963 in Syosset, New York. Williams earned a B.A. from Pennsylvania State University (1985) and a J.D. from Temple University School of Law (1992). She practiced in Newark from 1992 to 2009, served as a District of New Jersey magistrate judge from 2009 to 2021, and taught as an adjunct at Rutgers–Camden and Rowan University. President Biden nominated her to the district court.
